causal_parity.independent_tracker_states: Two newly constructed trackers per sequence initialize separately. Their template/history tensors and counters are independently allocated. They share one frozen eval model and the decoded current image; E0 predict does not retain per-tracker hidden state in that model.
causal_parity.control: Before each direct track, model.predict is set to observer.original, so the control bypasses the wrapper. It then switches to observer.predict for the observed track and resets observer bookkeeping.
every_frame_checks: Numerically exact unrounded returned post-clipping pixel xywh boxes
Entire template tensors, history tensors, frame and since_query
Exactly one original predict call in the observed track
causal_parity.sampling: Both trackers process every frame. Observation features are recorded only at valid frame indices divisible by five; other observed calls use the disabled wrapper.
causal_parity.equality_limit: Returned boxes are self.state.copy() after original image clipping. Pre-clipping pixel boxes, primary/final normalized predictor tensors and all intermediate neural tensors are not directly compared. The observer returns the unchanged original result object. The all_online_states_bit_equal claim is limited to the explicitly compared tracker state, not timing, allocator state or every possible object attribute.
causal_parity.freeze: freeze(model) disables parameter gradients and sets eval, the collector and observer use no_grad, all state_dict tensors are compared to their CPU clones at the end, and all parameter gradients must remain None. There is no optimizer/backward in collection.
causal_parity.forward_cost: Each tracked frame executes two complete original E0 predictions, one per tracker. The observer adds no neural forward. This collection cost must not be reported as single-tracker inference FPS.

labels_and_coverage.sharding: Manifest train order, names[shard::8]; all eight draft job lists and frame totals exactly match the actual manifest.
labels_and_coverage.frame_validation: Actual manifest RGB/TIR/box lengths match for all sequences; valid frame indices are sorted, unique and in bounds; every sequence has at least one valid fifth-frame sample.
labels_and_coverage.real_label_provenance: Read all 882 real TRAIN init.txt files. All 459435 annotation rows exactly equal manifest boxes. All valid-frame labels are finite with positive sizes. No selected image path points outside its TRAIN sequence, and sequence directories resolve into /data/wangwj/dataset/LasHeR0428/trainingset.
labels_and_coverage.label_timing: Frame zero GT initializes each tracker. For sampled later frames, the current-frame GT is consumed only after both track/update calls and parity assertions finish. It is used solely to compute final_iou and the saved partition label; it is not passed into predict, search geometry, template writes or history.
labels_and_coverage.no_future_or_test_supervision: No future image/label or test annotation file is used for online decisions or saved supervision. The complete manifest is parsed at startup, including resident future TRAIN annotations and dev metadata; dev/test names are used for exclusion. Parsing is distinct from feeding labels into policy.
labels_and_coverage.target_semantics: final_iou measures the observed final returned clipped box against the same current TRAIN frame. It is localization supervision, not identity, recoverability, candidate gain or a benchmark metric.
labels_and_coverage.heldout_limit: The original E0 checkpoint was trained on the component holdout; this partition measures new-head selection only, not independent generalization.
labels_and_coverage.input_binding_limit: The draft individually hashes 186 prefix images. The manifest binds every full-TRAIN image path and embedded annotation, but the remaining full image contents are not individually checksummed. Start/end input checks therefore do not establish full image-byte immutability. This explicit limitation is not converted into an artificial collection source blocker.
labels_and_coverage.persisted_evidence: Per sequence: float32 914-wide feature array, ordered labels CSV, full returned predictions NPY including initialization. Per shard: config with complete plan and digest, progress with complete sequence lengths/matched frames/sample counts, and COMPLETE with zero-update/frozen/parity fields and hashes of all persisted files.

M1.conclusion: The standalone head, fit-only normalization, three-class objective, metrics and checkpoint retention/reload logic pass the reviewed CPU engineering checks. The cache loader needs the concrete provenance fix below before real M1 training admission. This does not block full paired TRAIN collection.
checks_that_pass: Exactly eight caches; distinct shard indices 0..7 and exact ordered shard sequence assignments covering all 882 sequences once.
706 fit and 176 component-holdout names; TRAIN manifest hash, union equality, and dev/test disjointness.
Nonempty progress with exact ordered sequence list, full sequence lengths, full matched-frame counts and feature counts.
Ordered sample indices exactly equal all valid positive frame indices divisible by five; shape/dtype/finite checks and partition membership.
Artifact digest checks for declared artifacts and required config/progress/features/labels; cached receipt and native digest checks.
All three localization classes required in both fit and component holdout.
Normalization mean/std fitted only on fit. Constant fit channels use scale 1; holdout uses those saved fit statistics.
Only the 914->128->3 head is constructed and optimized; the protected E0 is not loaded by the trainer.
Classes: reliable for IoU >=0.5, uncertain for 0.1<=IoU<0.5, lost for IoU<0.1. GT/IoU is a loss target, never a head forward argument.
Unweighted CE, true-row confusion matrix, unweighted mean per-class recall, lost recall and reliable false-interruption fraction.
Best uses first epoch achieving maximum component-holdout macro recall. Latest five numbered checkpoints plus independent best/latest are preserved.

Latest checkpoint strict reload and bit-equal normalized-holdout probe before COMPLETE; synthetic integration also verifies saved best epoch, retention, changed head weights, loss decrease and artifact hashes.
M1.prefix_not_training_data: Re-read actual prefix features and labels: 90x914 finite float32 features; 89 reliable, one uncertain, zero lost; all three sequences belong to fit. Neither this cache nor the old 21e07 candidate cache may substitute for the complete protected-E0 inputs.
remaining_scope_limits: Macro recall is over classes pooled across frames, not an unweighted average over sequences.
False interruption fraction is an offline classification statistic; no online interruption policy is implemented.

The loader requires full-frame counters in progress/receipt but does not require predictions/<sequence>.npy in its required-artifact set or inspect their shape. Authentic collector receipts do include these arrays; their presence/shape belongs in final collection evidence verification before pinning caches. No claim that the trainer independently reconstructs trajectory parity is made.
Latest reload is a probe, not an all-sample or separate-process reload. Best is checked in synthetic tests, not a completed real training run.
No real M1 holdout result, recovery improvement or benchmark evidence exists. A final M1 plan/native run must be separately bound after the source fix and complete collection.

M2.conclusion: Candidate-local extraction, initial-anchor encoder interface and variable positive-sized candidate-set scoring are coherent as a standalone prototype. This is not admission of an identity dataset, real M2 training, online deployment, a global recovery module or M3 memory.
M2.candidate_evidence: Each normalized cxcywh candidate samples its own 3x3 ROI from the supplied row-major 16x16x768 primary grid. It returns a 768-vector and nine-point coverage. It does not obtain the other modality's deep feature grid for free, query outside the current crop, or encode missing evidence.
M2.coordinate_and_coverage_semantics: grid_sample uses x,y and align_corners=False, with feature centers at (index+0.5)/16. Coverage counts ROI sample centers in [0,1)^2, not exact box area or real-image validity inside a padded crop. M2 uses only modalities with all nine samples covered; neither covered modality means negative-infinity candidate score.
M2.anchor_interface: The helper matches real DualRGBT.encode(self, templates, image, indices=None), slicing each modality from [1,2,6,128,128] templates and [1,6,256,256] search. It makes two additional encoder calls under no_grad, requires eval and full sampled coverage, and returns a copied detached [1,2,768] anchor.
M2.initial_coordinate_conversion: Actual admitted CPU crop on TRAIN 2up frame zero returns normalized xywh [0.41785892844200134,0.3097785413265228,0.1642821878194809,0.3804429769515991]. Caller must convert to cxcywh [0.5,0.5,0.1642821878194809,0.3804429769515991] before anchor extraction. Passing crop_pair's target unchanged would be wrong. No production caller exists yet, and no such caller bug is asserted.
M2.anchor_cost_and_limit: Two real E0 encoder calls at initialization are an additional cost. Current tests use a synthetic encoder; this review checked the actual crop conversion and real encode signature without running the real network.
M2.set_contract: Inputs are anchor [B,2,768], candidates [B,N,2,768], coverage [B,N,2], with positive N allowed to vary between calls. CPU probes for N=1,2,7 produce [1,2], [1,3], [1,8] logits. Candidate permutation permutes the candidate logits while preserving the no-match logit.
M2.no_match_semantics: Output index zero is no trusted identity match in the supplied observed set. It is not STOP, retaining E0, issuing a recovery query or a memory commit. Indices 1..N refer to supplied candidate order.
M2.supervision_contract: identity_set_loss requires an externally established TRAIN set assignment. It rejects assigning a fully unobserved candidate as target. It cannot validate whether an externally supplied no-match/negative assignment is semantically true; future data collection must establish complete candidate-set identity labels, including distractors and absent-target cases. Unexecuted/unlabeled candidates cannot be relabeled as negatives.
M2.M1_cache_cannot_train_M2: M1 stores one 914-vector and final-box overlap label per sampled frame; it lacks dual-modal initial deep anchors, executed candidate-local feature sets, geometry/coverage and target-set assignments.
M2.integration_limit: No M2 import/call is added to E0 model/tracker/observer/collector/M1. No actual identity data collector, supervised trainer, calibrated recovery decision, anchor update policy or M3 memory mechanism is implemented.
M2.analytic_cost_limit: The documented head-only linear MAC expression is analytic and excludes encoder calls, ROI sampling and other operations. It is not a GPU profile, whole-model cost, real training result or benchmark.

findings.title: Bind admitted M1 caches to the actual reviewed collection plan and collector command
findings.problem: load_collection verifies file hashes and native.command==config.native_command, but never validates config.plan_sha256 or receipt.plan_sha256 against an admitted collection-plan file, never binds the embedded collector source/review to that plan, and never reconstructs the expected collector command. Two equal arbitrary command lists are accepted. Consequently the complete-cache gate can accept data whose own metadata contradicts its collection provenance.
